remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(hhctrl.ocx hhctrl.ocx.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(hhctrl regtypelib hhctrl_tlb.idl)

# hhctrl.ocx is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hhctrl-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(hhctrl_shims OBJECT chm.c content.c help.c hhctrl.c index.c search.c stream.c webbrowser.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(hhctrl_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libshlwapi libole32 liboleaut32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(hhctrl_shims)
add_dependencies(hhctrl_shims stdole2 wineheaders)
set(HHCTRL_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/hhctrl.ocx/hhctrl_tlb_t.o)
add_cargo_module(hhctrl hhctrl-cargo hhctrl.ocx
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hhctrl_shims psdk hhctrl_t ${HHCTRL_REUSED} uuid_sources)
